notes.title: Aksun – Demo Update 0.9.4g
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131176/821d453adbd3f7854e0d51219bf3edc60941779c.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Demo Update & Playtest Closure[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The [b]Aksun Playtest[/b] branch will officially close on [b]September 3[/b].[/p][p]However, you will still be able to keep playing the same build through the [b]Aksun Demo[/b] branch (already updated). Only your [i]tutorial progress data[/i] from the Playtest will be carried over to the Demo build.[/p][p][b]Why this change?[/b][/p][list][*][p]We originally planned to update the Demo in mid-September with our roadmap announcement.[/p][/*][*][p]But because so many of you requested a build to keep playing, we’ve decided to make the Demo available earlier than expected.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]How future builds will work[/b][/p][list][*][p]Each Demo build will first be tested through a [b]closed Playtest[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Then, 4–8 weeks later, it will be made public as the next Demo update.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]If you’d like to experience new builds early or help us by joining future Playtests, [/p][p][b]Please sign up here: [url="https://forms.gle/63YwZhTbw55Hoo226"]Apply for Future Playtests[/url][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Next Steps[/b][/p][list][*][p]The official [b]Roadmap Announcement[/b] will be shared via Steam in [b]mid-September[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131176/7bdefe9b4405a43b46cf5da754ad5c9f027d2ae6.png"][/img][/p][p]Discord: [url="https://discord.com/invite/ZcAeRzdbUg"]https://discord.com/invite/ZcAeRzdbUg[/url][/p][p]Thank you for your incredible support, and see you in the next run![/p][p]— The Aksun Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.9.2h
notes.notes:
[h2]🛠️ Hotfix 0.9.2h[/h2]
[b]This hotfix addresses several critical bugs identified in version 0.9.2g.[/b]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed mismatch between Tainted Sunjang’s attack range and visual indicator
[*]Removed player pushback mechanic from Jisil, Chapter 2 boss fight
[*]Updated internal version label for consistency
[*]Corrected language setting behavior
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Note 0.9.2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131176/b9d090f1df0c75df241bac25443430b44177a862.png[/img]

[h2]🛠️ Aksun Demo Patch 0.9.2[/h2]
[b]This update delivers pre-scheduled improvements and resolves key issues based on feedback from version 0.9.1.[/b]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Refined Artifact acquisition mechanics
[*]Replaced Artifact Chime cost system with single-choice selection
[*]Rebalanced and polished Artifact Chime Talents
[*]Implemented AutoAim functionality
[*]Enhanced VFX and indicator decals for clarity
[*]Added new features to the Settings menu
[*]Various minor UI and UX adjustments
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Resolved input freeze after obtaining Weapon Chime in the starting stage
[*]Fixed rare issue causing unexpected slowdown of game timescale
[*]Corrected malfunctioning Artifact Chime Talents
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131176/f72d3e840cd8f3f25972a1cbbc801b46eacaf261.png[/img]

[h2] 💌 Huge Thank you[/h2]

Thank you for playing the Demo ver.0.9.1. We have recieved a lot of feedbacks and heartwarming reviews from all around. This is helping us so much with the development, the things we should focus on and the things we over thought about. We appreciate it all and we are pushing ourselves to make a better game. Thank you!

[h2]📣 How You Can Help[/h2]

[*] [b]Tell us what you think[/b] — report bugs or share feedback via our Steam Discussions or Discord
[*] [b]Wishlist Aksun[/b] to support the team and stay updated on our next chapters
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Release Announcement
notes.notes:
[h1]The Casket Opens — Aksun Demo is Now Live![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131176/81f7e0473c2cca819260567ebf721374c8a3c253.png[/img]

[b]Wanderers,[/b]
The seal has cracked. The whispers have grown louder.
Today, we invite you to step into the cursed [b]Casket[/b] and face the beginning of Aksun.

🕯️ [b]The Aksun Demo is now available to play.[/b]
Experience the opening fragments of our shamanic roguelite — where forgotten spirits, cursed relics, and impossible choices await.

[h2]🧭 What to Expect in the Demo[/h2]

[list] [*] Brutal, responsive combat [*] Shamanic weapon systems tied to forgotten gods [*] A glimpse into the world and sorrow behind Aksun [*] Your first steps into a looped nightmare that remembers you [/list]
